 RB Bragantino vs Santos Prediction: The hosts will end the guests' draw streak at home
 Red Bull Bragantino Trends Finished 02/11/2026 2 : 1 Santos FC Trends Serie A – Round 34
 Anastasia Dudkina 02/11/2026 12:48 Statistics of the month: 164 165 3 49.4 % ROI:   -7.46 % Statistics Odds Bet Type Bookmaker Claim Bonus! Odds 2,02 Bet Type RB Bragantino to win Bookmaker Bonus 100 € Bet now! RB Bragantino vs Santos: Prediction for the match on 2 November 2026
 On November 2, RB Bragantino hosts Santos in another round of the Brazilian Championship, TelecomAsia offers a free prediction for the RB Bragantino vs Santos match, providing key statistics: team form, head-to-head history, and analysis of the odds across major betting markets.
 Receive Your Welcome Bonus RB Bragantino
 At home, the hosts are in good shape. Their last three home matches yielded seven points from a possible nine: a 3-0 win over Chapecoense, a 4-2 victory against Cruzeiro, and a 1-1 draw with Mirassol. Scoring eight goals in three home games marks their best attacking stretch of the season.
 Away from home, the situation is different. Their last two away matches ended in a 2-0 defeat to Palmeiras and a 1-1 draw with Remo, with a previous loss of 2-1 to Flamengo. RB Bragantino has struggled to earn points on the road, making their home matches crucial.
 The attack is performing more consistently than the defense. The team scores in most matches but also concedes regularly, with only one clean sheet in this stretch. This is more significant for the goals market than the final goal difference.
 Santos
 The visitors are currently in a draw-heavy phase. Their last three matches have ended without a win: a 0-0 draw with Palmeiras, a 1-1 draw with Bahia at home, and a previous loss to Atlético Mineiro 2-1. However, Santos has fared better in away matches, winning two of their last three: 2-1 against Fluminense and 2-1 against Remo.
 The team scores gradually but consistently. In five of their last six matches, Santos has found the net at least once, with only the game against Palmeiras ending without goals from either side.
 However, the defense does not appear solid: a 2-2 draw with Flamengo and a loss to Atlético Mineiro showed that the team struggles under pressure. Facing a home side that has gained momentum is risky.
 Head-to-Head Statistics: RB Bragantino vs Santos
 The history of this matchup favors Santos. In May, the visitors won 2-0, prior to which there was a goalless draw. In other encounters, the score has often leaned in their favor: 2-0 and 3-1. RB Bragantino's only recent victory in this fixture was a 2-1 win away last spring, along with a home draw of 2-2.

 Bragantino has taken seven points from three home matches — you can bet on the hosts to win at odds of 2.02. 
 The hosts scored eight goals in three home matches, so betting on over 2.5 goals is available at odds of 1.57. 
 Santos has scored in five of their last six matches — the odds for 'both teams to score' are 1.49. 
 A cautious option from the opposite side: under 2.5 goals is priced at odds of 2.31. 
 Insurance on the visitors — double chance X2 at odds of 1.65. 
 Bookmaker Odds for RB Bragantino vs Santos
 The hosts have a slight edge, with RB Bragantino's win priced at 2.02, Santos' success at 3.35, and a draw at 3.90. According to bookmakers, this gives the hosts about a 50% chance. For insurance options: double chance X2 at odds of 1.65, and for the hosts — 1X at 1.33. The goal line looks upward: over 2.5 is at 1.57, under 2.5 is at 2.31, while 'both teams to score - no' is priced at 2.40.
 Match Prediction for RB Bragantino vs Santos on November 2
 This match heavily favors the home factor. Bragantino has clearly divided into two teams this season: they earn points and score heavily at home, while they struggle to take anything on the road. This is indeed a home match.
 Santos arrives in a streak of draws. Three matches without a win, a sluggish game, and minimal goals in attack — yet the team consistently finds the net at least once. This detail prevents a bet on a clean win for the hosts.
 The history of the matchup favors the visitors, and this cannot be ignored. However, recent encounters have mostly taken place on Santos' turf, while at their own stadium, Bragantino has not lost to anyone during this stretch. Hence, the choice: a home win as the main bet, with overs on total goals and mutual scoring as additions.
 We are taking RB Bragantino to win: the home team has gained momentum and scores regularly, while Santos has failed to win for three matches in a row. We expect goals from both sides.
